content.certification: HashiCorp Certified - Terraform Authoring and Operations Professional

description-bullets.bullet: Lead the enterprise cloud platform vision and target-state architecture, establishing multi-account, hybrid-cloud foundations for mission-critical financial applications and core banking modernizations.

Partner with Enterprise Information Security and Risk Management to embed security-by-default architecture, automated compliance guardrails, and Zero Trust controls aligned with FFIEC and SOX standards.
Deliver self-service platform engineering capabilities and automated landing zones through reusable Infrastructure as Code (IaC) modules and CI/CD blueprints across banking lines of business.

Chair cloud architectural review boards while mentoring platform engineers and advising senior leadership on technology roadmaps, cloud financial operations (FinOps), and resilient disaster recovery strategies.

Assumed full operational and people management ownership of a 5-person engineering team, establishing an internal architectural review program and standardized intake framework that scaled reusable patterns and accelerated delivery.

Led the architectural separation of a shared enterprise cloud platform into three independently governed environments during a corporate divestment, defining IAM boundaries, network isolation, data ownership, and migration sequencing to eliminate cross-entity blast radius while maintaining 100% uptime.
Directed the implementation of a production-ready agentic AI framework via AWS Bedrock and Lyzr, establishing enterprise-wide standards for LLM guardrails and identity-scoped access.

Designed and deployed the organization’s first external-facing API platform using Amazon API Gateway, establishing secure patterns for authentication, authorization, rate limiting, and customer integration at scale.

Engineered a Zero Trust access architecture via Teleport across 50+ AWS accounts, eliminating 100% of standing IAM credentials. This transition replaced long-lived keys with short-lived certificates, reducing the lateral movement window to 4 hours and automating SOC2 session auditing.

Developed a standardized infrastructure delivery platform using Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, and policy-as-code (Checkov), enabling teams to self-service compliant infrastructure while preventing non-conformant deployments by default.
Led the architectural decision and execution to migrate critical infrastructure and workloads from Azure to AWS, balancing cost, reliability, security posture, and operational maturity.
Automated tag validation and governance into CI/CD pipelines to enforce CMDB standards, significantly improving cloud cost attribution, chargeback accuracy, and financial visibility.

Architected and managed a multi-region Azure environment for a 5,000+ employee enterprise using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) with Terraform to eliminate 100% of configuration drift and establish repeatable deployment patterns.
Defined and enforced CIS and SOX-aligned security controls across hybrid environments, improving audit readiness and reducing compliance risk.
Designed enterprise monitoring and alerting strategies to improve reliability and reduce mean time to detection for critical services.
Owned complex identity and collaboration infrastructure including Active Directory, Office 365, Exchange Online, and Teams.
Standardized endpoint configurations and deployment pipelines across 6,000+ devices using SCCM, reducing incident rates and improving security posture.
Led migration from MDT to SCCM for operating system deployments, simplifying management workflows and eliminating redundant infrastructure.
Contributed to the design and operation of the corporate Citrix environment supporting enterprise virtualization needs.
Implemented and maintained Windows Deployment Services to replace legacy PC build processes, achieving a 50 percent reduction in build times for the university community.
Led the implementation of a Dell KACE environment to centralize software updates, service desk operations, and asset management across multiple departments.
Architected and implemented a modernized Pharos Print Management system that significantly reduced administrative and billing costs while improving the student end-user experience.
Leveraged ITIL best practices to manage high-volume incident resolution, consistently restoring critical services within defined SLA guidelines for faculty, staff, and students.

objective.content: Technical leader specializing in enterprise cloud architecture, security-by-default infrastructure, and self-service platform engineering across AWS and Microsoft Azure. Proven track record leading high-ambiguity initiatives - including zero-downtime cloud separations, Zero Trust access transformations, policy-as-code landing zones, and enterprise AI guardrails - in regulated environments.

description-bullets.bullet: Architected and built a full-stack collectible card stock tracking and historical pricing platform monitoring 9 international marketplaces via an event-driven Azure Functions (Python 3.11) and Storage Queue pipeline with ETag optimistic concurrency.

Engineered a defense-in-depth API security boundary using Azure API Management (APIM), Cloudflare edge CSP/HSTS transform rules, Discord OAuth2 with custom HS256 JWT validation, header-stripping policies, and IP-restricted serverless compute provisioned in Terraform.

Built a containerized European marketplace scraper routed through a dedicated WireGuard EU VPN sidecar alongside a SvelteKit and TypeScript SPA featuring an isolated client-side demo mode and Discord DM/slash-command alert workflows.

skills.item: AWS (EKS, EC2, VPC, S3, API Gateway)

description-bullets.bullet: Orchestrated the comprehensive communication strategy for Tekko, a large-scale regional event generating an annual economic impact exceeding 5 million dollars.
Developed and expanded the 'Show Your Badge' partnership framework, resulting in measurable increases in event revenue and strengthening strategic ties with local Pittsburgh businesses.
Directed multi-channel brand engagement and industry outreach initiatives to expand attendee reach and maintain a high-visibility presence within the regional cultural sector.
